description: This file contains helper functions and type definitions for handling WebSocket handshake authentication, including security context resolution, pairing locality determination, device signature verification, and auth context management within a gateway server component.

methods.name: resolveBrowserOriginRateLimitKey
methods.description: Generates a rate limit key based on the request origin URL, defaulting to loopback IP if invalid or absent.

methods.name: resolveHandshakeBrowserSecurityContext
methods.description: Determines security context for handshake based on request origin, client IP, and rate limiters.

methods.name: shouldAllowSilentLocalPairing
methods.description: Decides if silent local pairing is permitted based on connection parameters and reason.

methods.name: isCliContainerLocalEquivalent
methods.description: Checks if the connection parameters indicate a CLI container local connection.

methods.name: resolvePairingLocality
methods.description: Determines the pairing locality (direct, CLI container, remote) based on connection parameters.

methods.name: shouldSkipLocalBackendSelfPairing
methods.description: Decides whether to skip self-pairing for backend clients based on connection and auth details.

methods.name: resolveSignatureToken
methods.description: Extracts the signature token from connection parameters.

methods.name: buildUnauthorizedHandshakeContext
methods.description: Constructs an unauthorized handshake context with auth info and next steps.

methods.name: resolveDeviceSignaturePayloadVersion
methods.description: Verifies device signature and determines payload version ('v3', 'v2', or null).

methods.name: resolveAuthProvidedKind
methods.description: Identifies the kind of authentication provided (password, token, bootstrap-token, device-token, or none).

methods.name: resolveUnauthorizedHandshakeContext
methods.description: Provides next steps for handshake authorization based on failure reason and auth context.
